主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced the redemption price for its 8.95% notes. The Form 6-K filing, dated March 1, 2013, incorporated by reference into the registration statement on Form F-9 (File No. 333-112049), includes the exhibit listing and signatures. The filing indicates the company is submitting the Form 6-K in paper as permitted by Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(1). The report was signed by B. D. Lawson, Managing Partner & CFO, on behalf of the registrant. The filing is related to the redemption price information for the 8.95% notes, which is a corporate action affecting the company's financial obligations and investor holdings.
